lead: A keep in the lab is not the official version yet. In production, the new version only goes up when the verdict says B won without making anything worse, someone approves it from the five-line card, and there is a way back that deletes nothing. In this lesson you redo the published verdicts from the LOOP-R example, promote, and roll back.
objetivo: read an A/B verdict with guardrails, show the 5-line card, promote only with approval, and roll back without deleting the version.

aprende.t: Promote: verdict + approval, with a commit
Rollback: the link goes back, the folder stays

hero_alt: Two-position industrial selector switch on a dark panel, one position marked with a yellow dot, next to a return lever.

secoes.titulo: From verdict to official version, and back
secoes.sub: The decidir, promover and reverter commands of the LOOP-R runner. Click each block.

nos.detalhe: Two-proportion z-test on the test metric, with a minimum N per variant. B only wins if it improves with significance and no "do not worsen" metric goes past tolerance. Below the minimum N: AMOSTRA_INSUFICIENTE, no "but it's winning".
Hypothesis, result with N and p, watched metrics, cost, and the three outcomes: approve, reject, wait. It's all the approver needs to read, at most once a week.

At L1, nothing goes up without decisao.md = aprovado. No answer by the deadline: pending, no promotion. Silence is never approval. L2 (automatic promotion) only after 5 promotions at L1 with no rollback (loop-r/docs/05 §7).
The candidate becomes v2, the versoes/atual link points to it, the ledger gets a PROMOVIDA line, and everything goes in one commit. The runner refuses without B_GANHOU and without approval.

Trigger: in the 1st cycle after the promotion, the test metric or a "do not worsen" metric falls below the previous version by more than the tolerance. The link goes back, the ledger records the reason, and the v2 folder stays: it is memory.

secoes.legenda: Runner invariants: never promote without B_GANHOU + approval, never delete a cycle, a version, or a memory line, never run two experiments at the same time.
secoes.dica: Rollback is not undoing the commit: it is a new commit that changes the link. The whole history stays in git.

secoes.titulo: The two published verdicts from the example
secoes.sub: The LOOP-R vendas-whatsapp example uses SYNTHETIC data (a generator with seeds chosen to reflect designed effects) and simulated human decisions; the agents ran for real. The kit redoes the math on a copy.

blocos.conteudo:
K=~/projetos/loop-r-eng-aprende-v72/kit
X=~/projetos/loop-r/exemplos/vendas-whatsapp   # git clone https://github.com/inematds/loop-r ~/projetos/loop-r (SYNTHETIC data)
E=${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/ensaio-aprende/a3; rm -rf $E; L=$E/loop   # a COPY: nothing is written to the loop-r repo
python3 $K/loopr.py iniciar $L --v1 $X/versoes/v1/executor.prompt.md --candidata $X/versoes/v2/executor.prompt.md
echo "## E0001 · H2 (até 80 palavras), tolerância 0 em reclamações"
python3 $K/loopr.py veredito $L --csv $X/dados/execucoes.csv --de 2026-02-02 --ate 2026-04-26 \
  --metrica resposta --minimo 166 --vigiar reclamou:0 --vigiar optout:0.005; echo "saída: $?"
echo "## E0002 · H3 (abrir citando um ponto da avaliação)"
python3 $K/loopr.py veredito $L --csv $X/dados/execucoes.csv --de 2026-05-04 --ate 2026-07-26 \
  --metrica resposta --minimo 212 --vigiar reclamou:0.01 --vigiar optout:0.005; echo "saída: $?"

abas.html:
loop iniciado: versoes/atual → v1
## E0001 · H2 (até 80 palavras), tolerância 0 em reclamações
VEREDITO: A_SEGUE
Métrica do teste: resposta  A=0.1933 (58/300)  B=0.2967 (89/300)  z=2.9426 p=0.0033
Vigiada reclamou: A 1/300 vs B 6/300, Δ=+0.0167 tol 0 → FALHA
Vigiada optout: A 0/300 vs B 1/300, Δ=+0.0033 tol 0.005 → DENTRO
saída: 1
## E0002 · H3 (abrir citando um ponto da avaliação)
VEREDITO: B_GANHOU
Métrica do teste: resposta  A=0.1933 (58/300)  B=0.2933 (88/300)  z=2.8543 p=0.0043
Vigiada reclamou: A 2/300 vs B 4/300, Δ=+0.0067 tol 0.01 → DENTRO
Vigiada optout: A 3/300 vs B 1/300, Δ=-0.0067 tol 0.005 → DENTRO
saída: 0

The same numbers as the published ledger: E0001 with 58/300 against 89/300 (z=2.94) was discarded because of complaints (6 against 1, tolerance 0); E0002 with 58/300 against 88/300 (z=2.85, p=0.004) won. Even with the 0.01 tolerance the example adopted later, E0001 would still fail (Δ=0.0167).

Reading only the test metric is not enough. E0001 had a bigger gain than E0002 and still could not go up: a guardrail went past the tolerance. And the tolerance is agreed before; changing it after seeing the number is rewriting the hypothesis.

secoes.sub: Continues the previous block. The card's cost is the sum of the cost.md of cycle 0004 of the example (5 agents, ~392 thousand tokens); the example also records it in reais, the course counts in tokens.

blocos.conteudo:
K=~/projetos/loop-r-eng-aprende-v72/kit
E=${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/ensaio-aprende/a3; L=$E/loop   # continues the previous block (verdict B_GANHOU recorded)
python3 $K/loopr.py promover $L; echo "saída: $?"
python3 $K/loopr.py cartao $L --hipotese "H3 — abrir citando a avaliação" --tokens 392000
python3 $K/loopr.py decidir $L aprovado --por "Seu Nome"
python3 $K/loopr.py promover $L; echo "atual → $(readlink $L/versoes/atual)"
python3 $K/loopr.py reverter $L --motivo "resposta caiu no 1º ciclo após a promoção"
echo "atual → $(readlink $L/versoes/atual) · pastas: $(ls $L/versoes | tr '\n' ' ')"
git -C $L log --format=%s

abas.html:
RECUSADO: promover exige veredito B_GANHOU e decisão aprovado (veredito: B_GANHOU; decisão: nenhuma)
saída: 1
CICLO — hipótese: "H3 — abrir citando a avaliação"
Resultado:   resposta 0.1933 → 0.2933  ((58/300) vs (88/300), z=2.8543, p=0.0043)  [VEREDITO: B_GANHOU]
Vigiado:     reclamou ok · optout ok
Custo:       392.000 tokens neste ciclo (sai da cota)
Decisão:     aprovar / rejeitar / esperar mais dados
decisão gravada: aprovado
PROMOVIDA: versoes/atual → v2
atual → v2
ROLLBACK: versoes/atual → v1 (a pasta v2 continua lá)
atual → v1 · pastas: atual v1 v2 
loop-r: rollback v2 → v1
loop-r: promote v2
loop-r: iniciar

The first attempt to promote is refused: good verdict, but nobody approved. After the rollback, atual points to v1 and both folders are still there.

secoes.titulo: The owner wants to promote now
secoes.sub: Simulated conversation. Version B's test is at half the sample. Choose what you answer.

abre.cliente: I saw the dashboard: version B has a 31% response rate and A has 20%. That's already 120 proposals on each side. Please promote it today.

opcoes.t: Not yet: the minimum is 212 per variant. Stopping when it's winning is the most common way to promote noise. At 50 per week, about four more weeks to go.
opcoes.comenta: That is the hard rule of LOOP-R: below the minimum N, AMOSTRA_INSUFICIENTE. You gave the number and the deadline.

opcoes.t: I'll promote it, and keep the rollback armed in case it gets worse.
opcoes.comenta: Rollback does not fix a decision made on noise: the version goes up without proof and the test is over.

opcoes.t: If the difference holds next week, I'll promote it.
opcoes.comenta: Better than today, but it is still stopping on a partial lead. The criterion is the minimum N, not the feeling that it keeps winning.

reclama.cliente: OK. But complaints went up: 1 on A and 3 on B. Isn't that a reason to stop now?

opcoes.t: It is the only reason to stop early: I run the verdict with the tolerance that is in the yaml. If it goes past it, B is out; if not, we continue to 212.
opcoes.comenta: Early stop only for a falling guardrail, with the tolerance agreed beforehand (loop-r/docs/05 §3).

opcoes.t: I set the tolerance to zero and stop: any extra complaint takes B down.
opcoes.comenta: Zero tolerance on a rare event discards a good hypothesis by chance. The example learned this in cycle 0002 and switched to 0.01.

opcoes.t: I'll leave it and only look at the end of the test.
opcoes.comenta: The end looks too, but a guardrail is exactly what you watch during the test: it is the only early stop allowed.

fim-bom.texto: B only goes up with 212 per variant, B_GANHOU with guardrails within bounds, and your "aprovado" on the card. If a watched metric goes past the tolerance before that, the test stops because of it, not because of the lead.

fim-meio.texto: You held back the promotion, but handled the guardrail poorly. The tolerance is agreed beforehand, and watched during the test.

fim-ruim.texto: At half the sample, 31% against 20% can be luck. The version went up without proof and the experiment lost its value.

secoes.licao: Promoting requires the minimum N, B_GANHOU with guardrails, and explicit approval. The only early stop is a guardrail falling past the tolerance agreed beforehand.

secoes.sub: Everything runs on a copy in /tmp: the kit never writes to the loop-r repository.

exercicios.pronto: E0001 → VEREDITO: A_SEGUE with FALHA on reclamou and saída: 1; E0002 → VEREDITO: B_GANHOU, z=2.8543 and saída: 0.
the first line starts with RECUSADO; then atual → v2, and at the end atual → v1 · pastas: atual v1 v2; git -C $L log --oneline | wc -l → 3.

exercicios.texto: For the lesson 1 hypothesis, write the tolerances for each "do not worsen" and the minimum N before you run. For a rare event, use at least 2 standard errors of the base rate in the planned sample (loop-r/docs/05 §2). Commit hipotese.md with the tolerances before the next cycle.
exercicios.pronto: H=$(git log --diff-filter=A --format=%ct -- hipotese.md | tail -1); C=$(git log --reverse --format=%ct --grep='^keep:' | head -1); [ -n "$H" ] && { [ -z "$C" ] || [ "$H" -lt "$C" ]; }; echo "saída: $?" → saída: 0 (hipotese.md entered git before the first keep), and the committed hipotese.md has a numeric tolerance for each "do not worsen".

perguntas.p: B raises the response rate from 19% to 30% with p=0.003, but complaints go past the tolerance. What is the verdict?
perguntas.explica: B only wins if it improves the test metric and no "do not worsen" goes past the tolerance. That was the case for E0001 in the example.

perguntas.p: The verdict was B_GANHOU and the approver did not respond by the deadline. What happens at L1?
opcoes: It stays pending and does not promote
It runs another experiment on top
perguntas.explica: Silence is not approval. Without decisao.md = approved, the runner refuses to promote.

perguntas.p: In the rollback from v2 to v1, what happens to the v2 folder?
opcoes: It stays there, as memory, and the ledger records the reason
It is moved out of the repo and only comes back with a new approval from the owner
perguntas.explica: Rollback changes the versoes/atual link and records the reason. Never deleting a version is a runner invariant.

perguntas.p: When is it allowed to stop a test before the minimum sample?
opcoes: When B is winning by a wide margin
When a guardrail drops beyond the tolerance
When the approver is in a hurry
perguntas.explica: The only early stop is by guardrail. Stopping for a partial lead promotes noise.

itens.texto: B wins with significance, minimum N and no guardrail outside the tolerance; otherwise A stays.
At L1, the five-line card goes to the human; without "aprovado", nothing goes up.
Rollback is a commit that changes the link and notes the reason; no version is deleted.
